html: † גִּתִּית f. of foregoing (si vera l.) only in phr. עַל־הַגִּתִּית in three ψ-titles: ψ 8:1; 81:1; 84:1; upon the Gittite (lyre) so 𝔗, to the Gittite (melody) Ew Ol De, or either of these Hup Pe; 𝔊 𝔙 הַגִּתֹּת wine-presses, whence Bae al. at the wine-presses, i.e. (Bae) a song for the feast of booths.
